facts.statement: Tagarosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform belonging to the protosuchian grade from the Early Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Tagarosuchus is an extinct genus of Early Cretaceous protosuchian-grade crocodyliform.

facts.statement: The genus Tagarosuchus was named in 1999, with Tagarosuchus kulemzini designated as the type species.
facts.quote: Tagarosuchus was named in 1999, with the type species being Tagarosuchus kulemzini.

facts.statement: Remains of Tagarosuchus have been recovered from the Aptian-Albian Ilek Formation.
facts.quote: Remains have been recovered from the Aptian-Albian Ilek Formation.

facts.statement: Tagarosuchus is classified within the parent group Protosuchia.
Tagarosuchus lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages, approximately 125.77 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Tagarosuchus coexisted with a diverse assemblage including various lizards, the crocodyliform Kyasuchus, the cynodont Xenocretosuchus, the mammal Gobiconodon, the dinosaur Psittacosaurus, troodontid theropods, and sauropods.
facts.quote: Tagarosuchus would have coexisted with paramacellodid, scincomorphan, and xenosaurid lizards, the shartegosuchid crocodyliform Kyasuchus, the tritylodontid cynodont Xenocretosuchus, the triconodont mammal Gobiconodon, the ceratopsian dinosaur Psittacosaurus, troodontid theropod dinosaurs, and sauropods, all of which have been described from the locality in the past few decades.

rejected.statement: Fossils of Tagarosuchus have been discovered in southern Siberia, including a nearly complete skull found near the village of Shestakovo.
rejected.quote: Fossils of Tagarosuchus have been found from southern Siberia, including a nearly complete skull found near the village of Shestakovo (Kemerovo Oblast)
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'southern Siberia including a nearly complete skull found'
